review_text: The app is fast and easy to use, and the home screen is very clear.
When I try to complete a payment, the app freezes and I have to start over.
Overall, it works well; I would like to be able to turn on dark mode.
I sent a request to support a week ago and still haven't received a reply.
The charts load quickly, and the daily summary saves me time.
Search finds no results unless I enter the exact project name.
Notifications arrive all at once, long after they are useful.
CSV export is useful; it would be great to choose which columns to include.
The app closes every time I open the invoices section.
The support agent solved my issue quickly and explained the steps clearly.
The text is too small on my tablet, so the details are hard to read.
The price went up, and I can't find a clear comparison of the available plans.
Changes made on my computer take several minutes to appear on my phone.
Since the latest update, I haven't been signed out unexpectedly. Great work.
After I enter the verification code, I return to the sign-in screen and have to start over.
The dashboard is useful, but I would like to save different filters for each project.
I was charged twice, and I can't find a way in the app to report the problem.
Search works, but date and status filters would make it easier to find tasks.
The reports are accurate, and the new monthly summary is easy to share.
I can't change the interface language, and some labels are hard to understand.
